verse.verse_1: When the sun is folded up,
verse.verse_2: and when the stars lose their light,
verse.verse_3: and when the mountains are moved,
verse.verse_4: when ten-month pregnant camels are left untended,
verse.verse_5: and when all beasts are gathered together,
verse.verse_6: and when the seas are set on fire,
verse.verse_7: when the souls are divided into different classes,
verse.verse_8: and when the female infant buried alive is asked
verse.verse_9: for what sin she was killed,
verse.verse_10: when the records of men's deeds are laid open,
verse.verse_12: and when Hell is set ablaze,
verse.verse_14: [then] each soul shall know what it has put forward.
verse.verse_15: I swear by the receding stars,
verse.verse_16: the planets that run their course and set,
verse.verse_18: and the first breath of morning.
verse.verse_19: Truly, this is the word brought by a noble messenger,
verse.verse_20: endowed with power and held in honour by the Lord of the Throne --
verse.verse_21: who is obeyed there and is worthy of trust.
verse.verse_22: Your companion is not one possessed:
verse.verse_23: he truly beheld him [the angel] on the clear horizon.
verse.verse_24: He is not avid of the Unseen.
verse.verse_25: Nor is this the word of an outcast devil.
verse.verse_27: This is merely a reminder to all mankind;
verse.verse_28: to every one of you who wishes to tread the straight path.
verse.verse_29: But you cannot will it unless God, the Lord of the Universe, so wills it [to show you that way].
